links.outcome: LLM diagnosis and treatment plan quality versus ophthalmologists on same cases, Likert 1-4
links.effect: Human experts mean 3.72 (SD 0.50); GPT-4 3.52 (0.64); Llama-3-70b 3.48 (0.48); GPT-4o 3.20 (0.81). Only GPT-4o differed significantly from humans; GPT-4 and Llama-3-70b comparable.
links.quote: GPT-4 and Llama-3-70b showed performance comparable to ophthalmologists, with no statistically significant differences.

screen.reason: Evaluated the standalone diagnostic and treatment plan accuracy of LLMs compared to human experts on 73 real-world emergency ophthalmology cases via expert grading, without evaluating a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
